pages.text: The heart stopped or the knockdown timer ran out — $(l)clinical death$(). The brain still holds but dies without CPR. Brain at zero — death for good.

To restart the heart: restore blood (at least ~$(cfg)55%%$()), do CPR, defibrillate fibrillation, give adrenaline.$(br2)For $(cfg)3$() h after revival the body is weak: a new knockdown is more dangerous.
